uk-supply-margins.summary: NESO issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice for 9 Nov amid low wind; none in force as of 13 Nov
uk-supply-margins.state: NESO issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice on the evening of 8 Nov for 06:00–11:00 on 9 Nov, forecasting a shortfall of about 1.4 GW against its required margin as wind output fell, and said there was no risk to supplies (BritBrief). That notice has lapsed, and no further Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice was found in force as of 13 Nov, so the signal stays Normal.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: A margin notice asks generators to make more power available and is not a warning of power cuts. Households need take no action; NESO and National Gas publish any further notices on their websites.
uk-supply-margins.rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notice in force on 13 Nov; the 8 Nov EMN covered only 9 Nov morning

uk-floods.summary: No flood warnings in force in England on 14 Nov; two lower-level flood alerts
uk-floods.state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings or flood warnings in force in England at 05:40 UTC on 14 Nov, and two lower-level flood alerts. This is well within the Normal band of fewer than 10 flood warnings.
uk-floods.for_you: No flood warnings are in force in England. The GOV.UK flood warning service shows live warnings and lets you sign up for alerts.

headline: The US–Iran conflict still drives the board: Iran said an LNG carrier hit a mine near Hormuz on 13 Nov and gas stays above €90/MWh. Russian strikes on Ukraine continue and DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has passed 11,000 cases.

situations.name: US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock
situations.summary: IRGC says it hit a US radar in Bahrain after a 12 Nov strike on Sirik; Iran says an LNG carrier hit a mine on 13 Nov; IAEA lacks access.

situations.name: Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank
situations.summary: Russian strikes killed at least 3 on 13 Nov; Baltic drone alerts 10–11 Nov; Abu Dhabi talks agreed a prisoner swap but no ceasefire.

situations.name: Super El Niño

situations.name: Ebola outbreak, DR Congo

situations.name: Sudan war
